period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's 2nd-Quarter (Half-Yearly) 2023 unaudited financial statements; the bank's own filing labels this a '2nd Quarter' report rather than 'Half Yearly' (naming changed from FY2022 onward) but the P&L still presents four columns [Jan-Jun 2023 cumulative] [Jan-Jun 2022 cumulative] [Apr-Jun 2023 discrete] [Apr-Jun 2022 discrete] exactly like the earlier 'Half Yearly' filings, so it is treated identically -- the first (cumulative) column is used here. Plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used (Solo+OBU basis). Comparative column (31 Dec 2022) reproduces the known FY2022 figures exactly. As in the prior two quarters, 'Profit before provision' prints without its negative sign despite being a loss; corrected via the identity chain, cross-checked against 'Profit before taxes (6,352,773,028)' and 'Net Profit after taxation (6,352,773,028)' (identical, confirming zero provision AND zero tax this half-year). The discrete Q2-2023 and cumulative H1-2022 comparative columns cross-check exactly against this dataset's own independently-derived 2022_Q2.json figures (H1-2022 PAT -1903.25m matches; discrete Apr-Jun 2022 PAT of -1273.04m is consistent with H1-2022 minus Q1-2022 from this dataset's own 2022_Q1.json and 2022_Q2.json). Source PDF was image-only; text obtained via OCR (tesseract, 300dpi). NOTE: National Bank's own Q3-2023 (Jul-Sep 2023) filing was searched for on the bank's official financial-statement archive page and is genuinely absent -- not published, not a extraction failure -- so 2023_Q3 is recorded as a gap.
